meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装了它之后，助手在完成写文件、改代码等编辑操作后，会自动检查代码注释；若发现警告，会先停下，要求修复或解释后再继续。
howto.when: 在成功的写文件、改代码、打补丁等编辑操作完成后，若注释检查器报告警告时触发。

say.text: 请修复这条被标记的注释。
say.note: 助手会直接修改对应代码注释。

say.text: 解释一下这个注释检查警告。
say.note: 助手会说明警告的具体原因。

say.text: 根据检查结果修复所有注释问题。
say.note: 助手会逐一处理并继续。

howto.what_en: After installation, this skill automatically checks code comments after successful edit operations like writing or modifying files. If a comment issue is found, it blocks progress until the flagged comment is fixed or explained.
howto.when_en: This triggers after successful edit-like operations (write, edit, apply_patch, etc.) when the comment checker reports a warning on a comment.

say_en.note: The assistant will directly update the comment in the code.
The assistant will describe why the warning occurred.

say_en.text: Fix all comment issues based on the check results.
say_en.note: The assistant will handle each one and move on.
